product_title: Resin Pink Shubh Labh Decorative Hanging Set with Pearl Tassels (3 inches)
product_description: Bring prosperity and elegance to your home with this beautiful Shubh Labh hanging set, featuring pink textured panels, golden lettering, floral embellishments, and pearl tassels. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, and entrances during Diwali and other festive occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle the pearl tassels and floral details carefully.
Store in the original box in a cool, dry place.
